businessModel: Non-profit funded by grants and donations; no ads or data sales
updateCadence: Follows Firefox ESR security releases, roughly every 2-4 weeks; 15.0.26 was an emergency CA fix
summary: Hardened Firefox ESR that sends all traffic through the Tor network with uniform fingerprints, first-party isolation and no telemetry. Desktop and Android; slow by design.
bestFor: Journalists, activists and anyone needing network anonymity
Bypassing censorship with bridges and Snowflake
notFor: People who want sync or heavy customisation

pros.title: Network anonymity
pros.detail: All traffic goes over three-hop Tor circuits, hiding your IP from sites.

pros.title: Uniform fingerprint
pros.detail: Letterboxing and resistFingerprinting make users look alike.

pros.title: Per-site isolation
pros.detail: First-party isolation and New Identity wipe state and circuits.

pros.title: Zero telemetry
pros.detail: No analytics; non-profit and fully open source.

pros.title: Censorship circumvention
pros.detail: Built-in bridges, Snowflake and Lyrebird transports.

pros.title: Prompt security fixes
pros.detail: Tracks Firefox ESR with emergency releases such as 15.0.26 (Oct 2026).

cons.title: Slow
cons.detail: Three-hop routing makes pages and downloads noticeably slower.

cons.title: Site breakage
cons.detail: Many sites block Tor exits or serve CAPTCHAs; streaming does not work.

cons.title: No iOS version
cons.detail: Apple rules forbid it; Tor recommends Onion Browser instead.

cons.title: Not a daily driver
cons.detail: No sync, no passwords, no media DRM, minimal customisation.

faq.q: Is Tor Browser available on iPhone?
faq.a: No official build; Tor Project points to Onion Browser, which uses WebKit and gets weaker protections.
The Tor Project discourages it because extra add-ons make your fingerprint unique.
Yes, Firefox ESR 140 in the stable 15.0 line; the 16 alpha moves to ESR 153.

switching.note: No import; start fresh by design. Bookmarks can be re-added manually.

privacyDefaults: Tor routing and RFP by default
blocking: Anchor: NoScript security levels, no ad blocker
